name: ShipLevy Fuel Surcharge Lite for WooCommerce
author: wcfuelsurcharge

sections.description:
ShipLevy Fuel Surcharge Lite for WooCommerce lets you add a configurable percentage-based fuel surcharge to shipping costs in your WooCommerce store. When a customer has a product from the selected category in their cart, the surcharge is automatically calculated as a percentage of the shipping total and displayed as a separate fee line item.

Features:

  • Enable or disable the surcharge with a single checkbox
  • Set a custom surcharge percentage
  • Choose one product category to trigger the surcharge
  • Customize the label shown to customers (cart, checkout, order emails, and invoices)
  • Optionally make the surcharge taxable
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

Looking for more?

Upgrade to ShipLevy Fuel Surcharge Pro for advanced features:

  • Apply the surcharge to multiple product categories at once
  • Trigger surcharge by WooCommerce shipping class (e.g. Heavy, Oversized, Freight)
  • “Select All” option to apply the surcharge store-wide
  • Priority email support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the shiplevy-fuel-surcharge-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Fuel Surcharge to configure the surcharge percentage, product category, and label.
sections.faq:
How is the surcharge calculated?

The surcharge is calculated as a percentage of the cart’s shipping total. For example, if shipping is $10.00 and you set the surcharge to 15%, a $1.50 fuel surcharge fee will be added.

Where does the surcharge appear?

The surcharge appears as a separate fee line item in the cart, checkout, order confirmation page, order emails, and invoices.

Can I apply the surcharge to multiple categories?

The Lite version supports one product category. To apply the surcharge to multiple categories or store-wide, upgrade to ShipLevy Fuel Surcharge Pro.

Is the surcharge taxable?

Yes, you can enable or disable tax on the surcharge from the settings page. When enabled, standard WooCommerce tax rules apply to the surcharge fee.

What happens if the cart has free shipping?

If the shipping total is zero (e.g., free shipping), no surcharge is applied since the surcharge is a percentage of the shipping cost.

Is this plugin compatible with HPOS?

Yes. ShipLevy Fuel Surcharge Lite for WooCommerce is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
